_rule: At most two variables under test at once. Everything else is held steady.

experiments.hypothesis: A confession/statement hook holds viewers longer than a question hook.
Slot 1 (08:00 IST) and slot 2 (20:30 IST) differ in reach and meaningful engagement for this account.
experiments.result: platform-specific: IG night slightly ahead, YouTube morning ~3.5x ahead; both slots kept
experiments.decision_rule: compare 7-day medians per platform once each arm has >=7 publications; until then 'insufficient data'

readings.reading: instagram: night (18-24 IST) median 1506 vs morning (06-12 IST) 1436 (n=9/13)
youtube: night (18-24 IST) median 351 vs morning (06-12 IST) 208 (n=11/8)

last 14 days (n=13/13 per arm): instagram night 1516 vs morning 1287; youtube morning 532 vs night 154. Platforms disagree, so no slot change under the EXP-002 rule; DEC-JR-010's 07:30/17:30 move (after the current queue clears) becomes the next test.

experiments.hypothesis: A comment question plus a small action beats a comment question alone on comments.
A hidden-feeling hook (one concrete moment + what the person pretended) earns more saves+sends per 1k reach on Instagram and more views on YouTube than a plain question/statement hook.
experiments.control: plain question or statement hook (JR-0021..JR-0049 baseline: IG (saves+shares) per 1k reach median 19.6, YT median views 319)
experiments.variant: hidden_feeling (JR-0052..JR-0059 rewrites and every new brief via review-rules R1)
experiments.success: variant IG (saves+shares)/1k reach >= 1.2x control median AND YT median views >= control median, at n>=7; read at the 2026-11-01 review
